weeks.title: Computational Problems, Algorithms, and Abstractions
weeks.progression_role: Establish the computational reasoning foundation required by subsequent study of intelligent systems.

weeks.title: Representation, Search, and Intelligent Reasoning
weeks.progression_role: Extend computational problem representation into foundational artificial-intelligence reasoning.

weeks.title: Learning from Data
weeks.progression_role: Transition from explicitly structured computation and reasoning toward systems that construct models from data.

weeks.title: Computational Investigation of Learning Systems
weeks.progression_role: Develop evidence-based understanding of machine-learning behavior through guided computational investigation.

weeks.title: Perception, Language, and Intelligent-System Integration
weeks.progression_role: Apply foundational representation and learning concepts to systems that process visual and language information.

weeks.title: Decision Making, Adaptation, and Autonomous Behavior
weeks.progression_role: Integrate reasoning and learning into goal-directed decision making, adaptation, and agent behavior.

weeks.title: Evaluating Intelligent Systems
weeks.progression_role: Shift from constructing and observing intelligent behavior toward evidence-based evaluation of reliability, limitations, human implications, and responsible use.

weeks.title: Guided Computational Inquiry and Synthesis
weeks.progression_role: Integrate computational reasoning, intelligent-system understanding, investigation, evaluation, and academic communication through a bounded guided inquiry.
